text:
I read all nine tracked files. Line numbers below are within each file.

## Critical: blocks indexing or AI visibility

1. **`public/robots.txt:4-8` blocks two AI search crawlers.**
   - `OAI-SearchBot` (lines 4-5) and `PerplexityBot` (lines 7-8) are fully disallowed.
   - Those two bots power ChatGPT search and Perplexity citations, so the site can't be cited there.
   - Fix: delete both blocks, or change them to `Allow: /`. If you want to opt out of model training, block `GPTBot` and `Google-Extended` instead. They are separate from the search bots.

2. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:8` has a hardcoded canonical.**
   - Every page canonicalises to `https://harbor.example/`.
   - That tells search engines `/moorings` and `/contact` are duplicates of the homepage, so they are likely to be dropped.
   - Fix: `<link rel="canonical" href={new URL(Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site)} />`.
   - This needs `site` set in an `astro.config.mjs`, which doesn't exist (see item 8).

3. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:9` sets `max-snippet:0` as the default robots value.**
   - It applies to every page except those that pass `robots`.
   - It forbids text snippets in search results, and AI Overviews and similar features use the same control.
   - Fix: default to `index, follow, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large`.

4. **`src/data/faq.json:8` has a corrupted key.**
   - The first question uses `" "` where `acceptedAnswer` should be, so that FAQ entry is invalid and gets no rich result.
   - Fix: rename the key to `"acceptedAnswer"`.

5. **`src/pages/moorings.astro:9` has invalid JSON-LD.**
   - There is a trailing comma after `"headline"`, so the block fails to parse and is ignored.
   - The `Article` type is also wrong for a pricing page, and it has no `author`, `datePublished` or `image`.
   - Fix: remove the comma and use `Service` or `Product` with `offers` (£40 per night). If it stays `Article`, add the missing fields.

## High

6. **`src/pages/contact.astro:4` is `noindex` but listed in the sitemap (`public/sitemap.xml:5`).**
   - The two signals conflict.
   - Fix: decide which you want. For a contact page you'd normally index it, so drop `robots="noindex"`. Otherwise remove it from the sitemap.

7. **`src/pages/index.astro:8` has FAQ schema with no matching visible content.**
   - The page renders only an `<h1>` and one sentence, while the JSON-LD contains FAQ answers.
   - Google requires structured data to match what's on the page, and AI engines extract from visible text.
   - Fix: render the questions and answers from `faq.json` in the page body.

8. **There is no `astro.config.*` and no sitemap integration (`package.json:9-12`).**
   - `public/sitemap.xml` is hand-maintained, has no `<lastmod>`, and will go stale.
   - Astro can't build absolute URLs without `site`.
   - Fix: add `astro.config.mjs` with `site: "https://<real-domain>"` and add `@astrojs/sitemap`.

9. **`https://harbor.example` is a placeholder domain.**
   - It appears in `public/robots.txt:10`, `public/sitemap.xml:3-5` and `Base.astro:8`.
   - Fix: replace it with the production domain, ideally from `Astro.site`.

## Medium

10. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:4-10` is missing basic head tags.**
    - Missing: `<meta charset>`, `<meta name="viewport">`, Open Graph and Twitter tags (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `og:url`), and a favicon.
    - Without the viewport tag, the pages fail mobile-friendliness checks.

11. **There is no organisation or local-business schema anywhere.**
    - It should be a `LocalBusiness` or `Organization` (with `Place`) on the homepage, with name, address, phone (01326 000000) and opening hours.
    - Entity data like this is what AI engines use to describe and cite you.
    - Fix: add it in `src/pages/index.astro` or `Base.astro`.

12. **`src/pages/index.astro:6` has a thin title and content.**
    - The title uses the US spelling "Harbor" while the H1 and description say "Falmouth harbour".
    - The body is a single sentence.
    - Fix: align the spelling, put the keyword in the title (for example "Falmouth Harbour Moorings – Visitor & Seasonal"), and add content on mooring types, how to book, and the water taxi.

13. **`src/pages/moorings.astro:7` has content too thin for a "sizes and prices" page.**
    - The description promises mooring sizes and seasonal prices, but the page only says "Prices start at £40 a night."
    - Fix: add a real pricing table (HTML `<table>`) with sizes and seasons. Tables are easy for LLMs to quote.

14. **`src/pages/contact.astro:5-6` has the phone number as plain text.**
    - Fix: use `<a href="tel:+441326000000">` and add address and email details.

## Low

15. **`src/components/Newsletter.jsx:2` is hydrated with `client:load` (`src/pages/moorings.astro:11`) for a form with no `action`, `name` or handler.**
    - It ships JavaScript for no benefit, and the form doesn't work.
    - Fix: make it a static `.astro` component with a real `action`, or use `client:visible`.

16. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:6` is the only place `title` is set, with no site-name suffix and no fallback.**
    - Fix: add a default title and a brand suffix.

17. **No `llms.txt` in `public/`.**
    - This is optional and not a ranking factor.
    - A short file describing the site and linking key pages is cheap to add.

I haven't changed anything. I can apply fixes 1-9 now if you want. Item 9 needs the real domain from you.
